title: How Many Humans Is a Judge Panel Worth?
abstract: arXiv:2609.21277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How many human judgments does a panel of language models represent? The answer depends on what is matched. We audit categorical judge panels against empirical human label distributions, retaining disagreement that binary errors relative to one gold label collapse. We measure spectral residual diversity by matching the participation ratio of a normalized residual Gram matrix to conditionally independent human-reference draws, giving nu_H. We separately match distributional squared error, giving nu_MSE. Across three ChaosNLI tasks, the same 32-judge panels have nu_H=4.24--6.50 but nu_MSE=2.30--3.75. A spectral identity separates the eigenvalues, member energies, and averaging-direction weights that determine error. Realizable hard-label panels show that greater spectral diversity can accompany worse distribution recovery even with equal member energies and nonnegative correlations. translated_title: 一个语言模型评审团相当于多少个人类评判者？
translated_abstract: 一组语言模型评审团究竟代表多少个人类判断？答案取决于匹配的对象是什么。我们针对经验人类标签分布对类别型评审团进行审计，保留了那些相对于单一金标准标签的二值错误所坍缩掉的分歧。我们通过将归一化残差格拉姆矩阵的参与率与条件独立的人类参考抽样相匹配来度量谱残差多样性，得到 ν_H；并单独匹配分布平方误差，得到 ν_MSE。在三个 ChaosNLI 任务上，同一组由 32 个评审组成的评审团，其 ν_H 为 4.24–6.50，而 ν_MSE 仅为 2.30–3.75。一个谱恒等式将决定误差的特征值、成员能量和平均方向权重分离开来。可实现的硬标签评审团表明，即使成员能量相等且相关性非负，更大的谱多样性也可能伴随更差的分布恢复。在观察到的评审团中，同规模内的排名一致性……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出两种不同的“等效人类评判者数量”度量——谱残差多样性 ν_H 与分布平方误差 ν_MSE，发现同一组 32 个语言模型评审在三个 ChaosNLI 任务上分别相当于约 4.24–6.50 个和 2.30–3.75 个人类评判者，且更大的谱多样性并不保证更好的分布恢复。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces two distinct "effective number of human raters" metrics—spectral residual diversity (ν_H) and distributional squared error (ν_MSE)—showing that the same 32-judge LLM panels equal 4.24–6.50 versus 2.30–3.75 human raters across three ChaosNLI tasks, and that greater spectral diversity does not guarantee better distribution recovery.
